draft.summary: Yemen's Houthis said they attacked Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura refinery, and their military spokesman said the attack caused fires. The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted and destroyed four drones in Ras Tanura but did not say the refinery was struck. NASA satellite imagery reviewed by Reuters showed large areas of thick black smoke around the refinery.
